Ugh...

[Patient]
*Moan*
scripts.translation:
[病人]
*呻吟*

scripts.text:
[Patient]
*Groan*
scripts.translation:
[病人]
*痛苦地呻吟*

scripts.text:
[Patient]
Aww... Ugh...

[Advance Base Defender]
This place is too dangerous. Return to the base, now!
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
这里太危险了。马上返回基地！

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
I'll see that no monster sneak into the base.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
我会确保没有魔物潜入基地。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Sigh, how long do I have to do this?
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
唉，我还要在这里守多久？

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Don't worry. I'm here to protect you.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
别担心，我会保护你的。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
We're in the middle of the battlefield. I can't talk for too long.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
我们正在战场上，不能聊太久。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Please step aside. You're blocking my vision.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
请让开，你挡住我的视线了。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
If you have time for chit-chat, then kill one more enemy instead.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
有时间闲聊，不如再去消灭一只敌人。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Bah, I'm cold and hungry... Oh, I was just talking to myself.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
唉，又冷又饿...啊，我刚才是在自言自语。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Be careful: this place is overrun with dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
小心，这里到处都是危险的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
For every monster I kill, one or more appear to take its place.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守卫]
我每消灭一只魔物，就会有一只或更多新的魔物出现。

scripts.text: [Advance Base Defender]
scripts.translation: [前哨基地守卫]

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with the dialogue because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续对话。 -

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You look super weak!
Why are you here??
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
你看起来也太弱了！
为什么来这里？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Well, there are not enough people!
But we will wait until you reach level 150.
Please come back later!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
唉，人手不够！
不过我们会等你升到150级。
请之后再来！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Have you noticed it, too?
Yes, the monsters in this area are really quite strange.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
你也注意到了吗？
没错，这里的魔物确实很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
They appear to be mutant versions of Midgard monsters
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
它们看起来像是米德加尔特魔物的变种。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Worse still, their number has been rapidly increasing.
We must keep an eye on them.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
更糟的是，它们的数量正在迅速增加。
我们必须密切关注。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
To my regret, everyone seems so busy that I can't ask them for help, despite the seriousness of the investigation.
This is not a safe environment.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
遗憾的是大家似乎都很忙，尽管调查非常紧急，我还是找不到人帮忙。
这里并不安全。

scripts.text: What's going on?
scripts.translation: 发生什么事了？

scripts.text: Why can't you do it yourself?
scripts.translation: 你为什么不自己去做？

scripts.text: Do you want me to do it?
scripts.translation: 要我去做吗？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
The environmental characteristics of this area are making the investigation too difficult.
The scenery looks familiar, yet in a way... strange.
The place looks like it's on the verge of utter collapse but.. I can see bursts of vibrant growth.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
这里的环境让调查变得非常困难。
景色看起来很熟悉，却又透着几分...诡异。
这里仿佛随时会彻底崩塌，但...我又看到了蓬勃生长的景象。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
What is this place?
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
这到底是什么地方？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Like everyone else from a noble background,
I only know how to command others.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
和其他出身贵族的人一样，
我只会命令别人。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Of all those monsters,
^0000FFFire Condors^000000 look most dangerous.
Those birds with burning tails charge headlong toward everyone they see. You may be able to run from them, but you will always get singed.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
所有魔物当中，
^0000FF火焰秃鹰^000000最危险。
那些尾巴燃烧的鸟会朝看到的所有人猛冲。你或许能逃开，但总会被燎到。

scripts.text: Do you want me to hunt Fire Condors?
scripts.translation: 要我去猎杀火焰秃鹰吗？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
No, I have no one to dispose their carcasses.
My purpose is, after all, an investigation.
Just bring me
15 ^FF0000Burning Feathers^000000
from ^0000FFFire Condors^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
不，我没人手处理它们的尸体。
毕竟我来这里是为了调查。
你只要带给我
15根^FF0000燃烧羽毛^000000，都是从^0000FF火焰秃鹰^000000身上收集的。

scripts.text: I'm as busy as you!
scripts.translation: 我也和你一样忙！

scripts.text: Got it.
scripts.translation: 知道了。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You acted as if you'd help me.
Were you messing with me?
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
你刚才表现得像是要帮我。
是在耍我吗？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Bring me
^FF000015 Burning Feathers^000000
from ^0000FFFire Condors^000000.
Hurry before more people fall victim to those vicious birds!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
带给我
^FF000015根燃烧羽毛^000000，都是从^0000FF火焰秃鹰^000000身上收集的。
快点，别让更多人遭那些凶鸟毒手！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I thought you'd be hard at work by now,
gathering ^FF000015 Burning Feathers^000000
from ^0000FFFire Condors^000000,
so I called an emergency meeting of
my investigators.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
我以为你现在应该已经在努力收集
^FF000015根燃烧羽毛^000000，都是从^0000FF火焰秃鹰^000000身上收集的，
所以召集调查员们开了紧急会议。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
And you're still in town,
enjoying a leisurely walk.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
而你还在城里
悠闲地散步。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You brought
all the ^FF000015 Burning Feathers^000000.
Thank you. Now I can
proceed with my investigation.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
你把
全部^FF000015根燃烧羽毛^000000都带来了。
谢谢，现在我可以
继续调查了。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Most of all, I can finally enjoy the warmth of a fire!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
最重要的是，我终于能享受火焰的温暖了！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Did you notice the worrisome expression on my face?
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
你注意到我脸上忧心忡忡的表情了吗？

scripts.text: Nope. Never.
scripts.translation: 才没有，完全没注意到。

scripts.text: I did, instantly.
scripts.translation: 我立刻就注意到了。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
That's not the answer I expected,
but I'll continue with the spiel
I've prepared.
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
这不是我预想的回答，
不过我还是继续念准备好的台词吧。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
A scout hasn't returned
from the Flaming Basin.
I want you to go check
what happened to him.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
一名侦察兵去了烈焰盆地后一直没回来。
我想让你去看看他出了什么事。

scripts.text: No can do.
scripts.translation: 我办不到。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I know you'll do it anyway!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
我就知道你还是会去的！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
The scout headed for the area teeming with monsters.
Keep your eyes peeled for him.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
那名侦察兵去了魔物成群的区域。
留意一下他的下落。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Not bad! You guys....
Please eat three bowls of gongs!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
干得不错！你们...
来吃三碗米饭吧！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
A scout hasn't returned
from the Flaming Basin.
I want you to go check
what happened to him.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
一名侦察兵去了烈焰盆地后一直没回来。
我想让你去看看他出了什么事。

scripts.text: No can do.
scripts.translation: 我办不到。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I know you'll do it anyway!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
我就知道你还是会去的！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
The scout headed for the area teeming with monsters.
Keep your eyes peeled for him.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
那名侦察兵去了魔物成群的区域。
留意一下他的下落。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I sent you out to look for the scout.
Did you come back or haven't you left at all?
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
我派你去找侦察兵了。
你是回来复命了，还是根本没出发？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Go look for the scout in the place teeming with monsters!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
去魔物成群的地方找侦察兵！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Did you find the scout?
He's resting and rewriting his scout journal?
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
找到侦察兵了吗？
他正在休息并重写侦察日志？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
He does not disappoint me.
He's a good soldier!
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
他果然没让我失望。
真是个好士兵！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Now that we've found the missing scout,
I want you to move on to the next mission.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
既然找到了失踪的侦察兵，
接下来该执行下一个任务了。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You know the number of mysterious monsters
in this Flaming Basin has been continuously increasing.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
你也知道，这片烈焰盆地里
神秘魔物的数量一直在增加。

scripts.text: I know.
scripts.translation: 我知道。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Things could quickly go out of control
if they expand to the outside world.
If they encounter other monsters in Midgard or the Other World,
they could go on a rampage,
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
如果它们扩散到外界，
局势很快就会失控。
如果它们在米德加尔特或异世界遇到其他魔物，
可能会大肆作乱，

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
could spread deadly virus,
could procreate powerful mutants,
or worse.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
还可能传播致命病毒、
繁殖出强大的变异体，
甚至造成更糟的后果。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
For now, the best solution would be
a large cull, and I want you to do it.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
目前最好的办法是
大规模清剿，我想请你们去做。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Please exterminate
20 ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000
and ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
请消灭
20只^0000FF火焰沙人^000000
和^0000FF火焰伞蜥^000000。

scripts.text: Do it yourself!
scripts.translation: 你自己去！

scripts.text: I'll do my best.
scripts.translation: 我会尽力。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I hate to repeat myself,
but like everyone else from a noble background,
I only know how to command others.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
我不想重复，
但和其他出身贵族的人一样，
我只会命令别人。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Hurry, those monsters are breeding even as we speak.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
快点，那些魔物还在不断繁殖。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Please exterminate
20 ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000
and 20 ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
请消灭
20只^0000FF火焰沙人^000000
和20只^0000FF火焰伞蜥^000000。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You exterminated
20 ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000
and 20 ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000 as I ordered.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
你照我的吩咐消灭了
20只^0000FF火焰沙人^000000
和20只^0000FF火焰伞蜥^000000。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Thanks to you we've found an effective wayto deal with the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
多亏了你们，我们找到了对付这些魔物的有效方法。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
From this moment on, my soldiers will take over.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
从现在起，我的士兵会接手。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Hurry, those monsters are
multiplying themselves even as we speak.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
快点，那些魔物还在不断繁殖。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Please exterminate
20 ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000
and 20 ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
请消灭
20只^0000FF火焰沙人^000000
和20只^0000FF火焰伞蜥^000000。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
So leave it to us to take care of this area, and you go ahead and head north.
I want you to do something about that strange group of people over there.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
这片区域交给我们处理，你继续往北走。
去处理一下那边那群奇怪的人。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
They've appeared out of nowhere.
doing everything they can to pester us.
scripts.translation:
[基地调查员]
他们突然冒了出来，
想方设法骚扰我们。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with the dialogue because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续对话。 -

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I was sent to investigate these monsters.
It's unfair that I'm alone
in this dangerous place with no backup!
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
我是来调查这些魔物的。
这么危险的地方居然没有支援，让我一个人待着，太不公平了！

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I was sent to investigate these monsters.
It's unfair that I'm alone
in this dangerous place with no backup!
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
我是来调查这些魔物的。
这么危险的地方居然没有支援，让我一个人待着，太不公平了！

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Argh, I'm just gonna go AWOL!
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
啊，我干脆擅离职守算了！

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Welcome!
I'm in dire need of help!
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
来得正好！
我急需帮助！

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I came here alone on a recon mission.
A horde of monsters surrounded me, keeping me from leaving,
so I had no choice but to hang around.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
我独自来执行侦察任务。
一大群魔物包围了我，害我没法离开，
只能一直躲在这里。

scripts.text: Stay chilling then.
scripts.translation: 那你就继续待着呗。

scripts.text: Let's go back with me.
scripts.translation: 跟我一起回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
You're afraid I might ask for help,
I see.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
看来你是怕我开口求助啊。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I'm not injured, save a few scrapes,
but ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000 stole
my ^FF0000scout journal^000000.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
除了几处擦伤，我没受什么伤，
但^0000FF火焰沙人^000000抢走了
我的^FF0000侦察日志^000000。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Without the ^FF0000scout journal^000000, I can't go back.
I'll be lucky
if my superiors don't court-martial me.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
没有^FF0000侦察日志^000000，我就没法回去。
要是上级不把我送上军事法庭，我就谢天谢地了。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Don't I sound pitiful?
Doesn't it inspire you to help me?
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
我是不是很可怜？
这样还不能让你想帮帮我吗？

scripts.text: Neh.
scripts.translation: 才不呢。

scripts.text: It does.
scripts.translation: 是有点。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
All right, then I'll just have to
stay here and chill until help arrives.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
好吧，那我就继续在这里歇着，
等救援来吧。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Okay, here's what you can do to help:
Please bring ^FF0000Scout Journals^000000
from ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
好吧，你可以这样帮我：
带回^FF0000侦察日志^000000，
这些日志在^0000FF火焰沙人^000000那里。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
The journal could have been separated into pages, snapped at by those feral monsters.
I don't care; I still need them to show to my superiors.
Please bring me
20 ^FF0000Scout Journals^000000.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
那些野蛮魔物可能把日志撕成了碎页，还咬坏了。
我不在乎，还是得拿它们给上级看。
请给我
20份^FF0000侦察日志^000000。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Be careful--they can ambush you and snatch away ^FF0000Scout Journals^000000 before you know it.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
小心，它们可能会伏击你，
趁你不注意抢走^FF0000侦察日志^000000。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Please bring 20 ^FF0000Scout Journals^000000
from ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
请带回20份^FF0000侦察日志^000000，
这些日志在^0000FF火焰沙人^000000那里。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Be careful--they can ambush you and snatch away ^FF0000Scout Journals^000000 before you know it.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
小心，它们可能会伏击你，
趁你不注意抢走^FF0000侦察日志^000000。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Did you already find
20 ^FF0000Scout Journals^000000?
If I knew you're so fast, I would have asked you for 100 pages instead.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
你已经找到
20份^FF0000侦察日志^000000了吗？
早知道你这么快，我就该让你找100页了。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
My wounds are throbbing from the thought of punishment
that might await me at the base.
scripts.translation:
[侦察兵]
一想到基地里可能等着我的惩罚，
我的伤口就开始隐隐作痛。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I'll follow you as soon as I'm done reorganizing these pages.
Please report to the Investigator
and put in a good word
